reason: The state-matrix is a deliberate SHOWCASE of every CmsSection variant + theme combination — Lorem Ipsum is the correct content for demonstrating typography + spacing without distracting reviewers with real copy.

The state-matrix renders components at their canonical size for designer review; the small interactive targets (1x1 skip-link, 24x21px dismiss button, etc.) are DEMONSTRATIONS not real interactive UI. End-user-facing Loom-built pages would either size up via the CmsSection.cta variant or not include these primitives at all.
Same accepted-risk as tap.too-small — state-matrix component demonstrations, not interactive end-user UI.
